description: This file defines routing logic for a Flutter application, including route constants and a RouteFactory for navigation between different tabs, along with route-to-index mapping.

classes.name: AppRoutes
classes.description: Holds the named route constants for navigation between tabs.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: Configures route generation for navigation, providing a RouteFactory and route-to-index mapping.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Returns a RouteFactory that builds a MaterialPageRoute and passes the target tab index for navigation.

methods.name: _indexForRoute
methods.description: Maps route names to their corresponding tab index.
